title: Dark Seed II
overview:
One year after the nightmarish adventure of "Dark Seed."

The shadow of the Dark World creeps up on Mike Dawson, who had returned to his hometown to live quietly. The invasion of the Ancients has begun again!

His former girlfriend Rita is murdered, and Mike himself ends up hunted by the police as the suspect.

To protect this world from the invasion of the Ancients, and to save himself, Mike's adventure begins once more...

あの「DARKSEED」の悪夢の様な冒険から1年。

生まれ故郷に戻り静かに暮らしていたマイク・ドーソンに忍び寄るダークワールドの影。古き神々の侵攻が再び始まったのだ！

かつての恋人リタは惨殺され、マイク自身もその容疑者として警察に追われる事になってしまう。

古き神々の侵攻からこの世界を守るため、そして自分自身を救うため、マイクの冒険が再び始まる・・・。
